theme_rankings.tagline: 🤖 크립토 버전 AI 베팅 — 분산 컴퓨팅·에이전트
theme_rankings.why_now: AI Capex 사이클의 크립토 노출. 미국 AI 주식 테마와 동행 흐름.
theme_rankings.risk: 내러티브 의존도 큼. 실수요 검증 아직 미흡. 알트 변동성 폭.

theme_rankings.why_now: 거버넌스보단 실제 트래픽·결제 사용처. TON·BNB 일일 활성 유저 검증.
theme_rankings.risk: 투기 대비 변동성 낮지만 폭발력도 작음. 환희장에서 underperform.

theme_rankings.tagline: 🌐 검증된 L1 — 이더 외 실수요 입증된 체인들
theme_rankings.why_now: 솔라나 압도적 점유 + 신흥 L1(Sui·Aptos)도 자금 유입. 생태계 prop value 확보.
theme_rankings.risk: L1 간 경쟁 격화. 사용자·개발자 이탈 시 멀티플 빠르게 축소.

theme_rankings.why_now: 실제 매출 + 토큰 보유자 환원. P/S 가시화로 밸류에이션 재평가 단계.
theme_rankings.risk: 스마트컨트랙트 위험 + 규제. 매출은 시장 변동성에 큰 폭으로 변동.

theme_rankings.tagline: 📈 ETF 승인 후보 + 이더 L2 — 기관 매집 영역
theme_rankings.why_now: SOL·LTC ETF 가능성 + L2 거래량 회복. 다음 cycle 메이저 후보.
theme_rankings.risk: ETF 미승인 시 단기 조정. L2는 fee market 경쟁 심화.

theme_rankings.tagline: 🥇 시장 방향성 기준 — 비트는 디지털 금, 이더는 인프라
theme_rankings.why_now: BTC ETF 자금 유입, ETH 스테이킹 + L2 매출. 알트 사이클의 출발점.
theme_rankings.risk: 거시 유동성·금리에 직접 노출. ETF 자금 흐름이 단기 방향성을 좌우.

theme_rankings.why_now: 토큰 가격은 하락했지만 매출 폭증 중. AI Capex 사이클의 크립토 노출 직접.
theme_rankings.risk: 토큰 인플레이션 압력 + 사용자 보상 의존. 베어 마켓에서 매도 압력 큼.

theme_rankings.why_now: 기관 자금 유입 가장 빠른 영역. BlackRock·Franklin 등 진입.
theme_rankings.risk: 규제 의존적. 거시 금리 환경 변화 시 단기 자금 이탈 가능.

top_news.title: US Futures Fall as Alphabet, Samsung Disappoint: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: US stock-index futures retreated after both Samsung Electronics Co. and Alphabet Inc.’s earnings disappointed, reviving concerns about the billions of dollars companies are pouring into artificial intelligence.

top_news.title: Ambani Magic Captivates India Once More With Blockbuster Deal
top_news.summary: Mukesh Ambani’s ability to raise billions of dollars and win over investors has endured for decades. He showed it once again with Jio Platforms Ltd., which pulled off India’s biggest-ever initial public offering and a strong trading debut despite a difficult market backdrop.

top_news.title: China’s Green Exports Enough to Offset Brazil’s Emissions: CREA
top_news.summary: Chinese exports of clean technologies this year could offset the equivalent of Brazil’s annual emissions from fossil fuels, underscoring the Asian country’s role in speeding up the global energy transition.

top_news.title: Gold Edges Lower After Fed Holds Rates With Limited Guidance
top_news.summary: Gold dipped after the Federal Reserve kept interest rates unchanged and offered little guidance on its next move, leaving traders guessing over the prospect of a hike before year-end.

top_news.title: China Bonds Rally As Gloom Deepens Over Stocks
top_news.summary: “Bloomberg: The China Show” is your definitive source for news and analysis on the world's second-biggest economy. From politics and policy to tech and trends, Yvonne Man and David Ingles give global investors unique insight, delivering in-depth discussions with the newsmakers who matter. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Sprouts Sinks After Outlook Cut on Cyclospora, Consumer Woes
top_news.summary: Sprouts Farmers Market Inc. shares tumbled after slashing its outlook, as the grocer’s sales suffered from the cyclospora lettuce outbreak and a gloomy consumer.

top_news.title: Fed Officials Left Interest Rates Unchanged
top_news.summary: Jon Ferro, Lisa Abramowicz and Tom Keene host a special edition of "Bloomberg Surveillance" as the Federal Open Market Committee voted 10-2 to hold its benchmark federal funds rate in a range of 3.75% to 4% and leave interest rates unchanged. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Stocks Edge Higher After Fed as Oracle Surges 11%: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: Stocks edged up as the Federal Reserve held rates steady and refrained from offering a clear signal on whether it will hike in December.

top_news.title: The Fed Will Deliver Price Stability, Warsh Says
top_news.summary: Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh holds a press conference after officials kept interest rates unchanged. He says inflation is still too high and policy makers will "deliver price stability." (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Global Bond Sales Shatter Record, Fueled by AI Borrowing Binge
top_news.summary: Global bond sales have soared to an all-time high, catapulted by breakneck borrowing from the tech juggernauts at the forefront of the AI boom.
